_meta.note: MBP-1005-MAYORS: five active big-city mayors still carried next_election 2025. All five Nov 2025 races are decided; roll next_election forward and record the result. Profile/notes only; no cells.

andre-dickens@GA.notes_append: [2026-10-05] Re-elected Nov 4 2025 to a second four-year term (USA Today, AP projection). Next election 2029.

vi-lyles-mayor@NC.notes_append: [2026-10-05] Re-elected Nov 4 2025 to a fifth two-year term, 70% over Terrie Donovan (R) 25.8% (WFAE). Next election 2027.

jacob-frey@MN.notes_append: [2026-10-05] Re-elected Nov 2025 to a third four-year term over Omar Fateh after ranked-choice tabulation (city official results; MPR). Frey said it will be his last term. Next election 2029.

corey-oconnor@PA.notes_append: [2026-10-05] Elected 62nd mayor of Pittsburgh Nov 4 2025, defeating Tony Moreno (R) (Post-Gazette); took office Jan 2026. Next election 2029.

justin-bibb@OH.notes_append: [2026-10-05] Re-elected Nov 4 2025 to a second four-year term, defeating Laverne Gore (R) (Signal Cleveland). Next election 2029.
